name: llm-qwen3.5-2b
description: Qwen3.5-2B (text model) read at the answer token, with SemIf's JSON prompt layout. Zero-shot, no fine-tuning by this project.
summary: A mid-size model: 66% with about half the memory of the 4B models.
use_when: You have 4-6 GB to spare and want better reasoning than the smallest models.
avoid_when: Speed is the priority: llm-qwen3-4b is faster and more accurate if you have the memory.

calibration.note: Fitted with training/calibrate.py on held-back rows of data/calib.jsonl (public gold-labelled tasks): choice and yes/no minimise negative log-likelihood, score minimises the error of the expected level.
